scope: Hash-bound AC1021 physical HEADER page and decoded envelope accounting for one external local sample; no parser behavior was changed.

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
rules: The section map identifies the HEADER section and its physical page references.
The decoded AcDb:Header envelope contains a begin sentinel, declared data size, CRC, and end sentinel; compare its trailer end to the decoded logical-section size when accounting for suffix bytes.

source.provenanceLimit: The file is from a local ACadSharp sample checkout; its producer and source-generation provenance were not established. It is not a repository fixture.

decodedHeaderEnvelope.crcDisposition: The instrumented reader trace prints matching stored and calculated values; this is a reader self-check, not an independent CRC implementation.

implementationObservation.observation: The reader parsed the HEADER envelope with zero unclaimed bytes and published all 925 observed source frames. Strict DXF export later refused because the IMAGEDEF owner role is unqualified; this is not a HEADER failure.

limitations: One local sample with unknown producer provenance does not qualify an AC1021 producer profile.
This exact-envelope sample does not classify the separate AC1021 maintenance-55 unclaimed-suffix witness documented in p6-ac1021-oda-header-suffix-diagnostic-admission-2026-11-03.json.
No output or support claim is promoted; strict output continues to refuse the unqualified IMAGEDEF owner role and unexplained suffix profiles.
